resources.string: Share your cycle, send doodles and leave little surprises for each other!
Encrypted file from afar or Bluetooth nearby.
Nothing syncs automatically. Each exchange is started by you.

Send the invitation once, as a file or a message in any messenger. Both phones show the same code. Look, then tap Connect. You do not type anything: with internet the confirmation arrives by itself and the chat opens.\n\nFile and Bluetooth are only for when there is no internet. A new invitation is needed only if you delete the contact or change phones.
The code should match on both phones. Tap Connect — with internet the confirmation arrives by itself.
You can now exchange data and little messages. Your next exchanges will check the trusted keys automatically.
For a new connection with a short verification code, update Ritela on the other phone. Existing trusted contacts keep working.
Draw a doodle, leave a message or plan a little surprise.
Shared information will appear here after you receive an exchange.
